denominator: One interval per source fictional firm at every adjacent supplied calendar-year pair, before production complete-case filtering; interval-only rows never count as source observations

units.levels: reported monetary candidate units; no verified conversion or deflation

decision: Use official psid/predecessor linkage. Matched next-calendar-year assignment means simulated disappearance0; unmatched means1. Endpoint-only rows have no obs_id or invented output. This is not authenticated economic closure.
missingness: Missing/zero/negative remain distinct; no imputation; unsupported statistical results remain missing and every skipped/failed obligation is retained
panel_mode: official synthetic_development; real linkage not required or claimed
